correctness.rationale: The 13-vertex Cayley graph and all 26 clique triangles are reconstructed exactly. The mod-two boundary rank 25 gives H1 dimension two. Two 8-edge explicit cocycles pair as (1,0), (0,1), (1,1) on three essential 4-cycles. Independent count via common neighbors gives 78 four-cycles; two affine orbits of 39 exhaust them, the null orbit is witnessed by two triangles, and the essential orbit splits into three translation orbits of size 13. Three-cycles all bound faces, proving minimality. The packaged checker replays every finite certificate.
